disorder-name.detail: Autism Spectrum Disorder diagnosed by experienced child psychiatrist or developmental pediatrician following DSM-5 criteria. Children aged 1-6 years. Excluded if comorbid genetic or major neurological disorders (e.g., epilepsy), unable to complete MRI, or significant structural brain abnormalities.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "A clinical diagnosis of ASD was established by an experienced child psychiatrist or developmental pediatrician following a comprehensive evaluation based on the criteria of the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders, Fifth Edition (DSM-5)."

dataset-of-origin.detail: Dataset 2: data collected at Zhejiang Children's Hospital, Zhejiang University School of Medicine. No publicly named dataset.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "This study utilized two brain imaging datasets collected at Zhejiang Children's Hospital, Zhejiang University. ... Dataset 2 includes brain images from 26 children with ASD and 41 TDC children."

age.detail: Age range 1-6 years stated for all Dataset 2 participants (ASD and TDC). No mean or SD reported separately for the ASD group.
age.supporting_text: "All participants were between 1 and 6 years of age at the time of the scan."

sex.detail: From Table 1 (ASD Group): Female = 10, Male = 16, Total = 26. Percentages calculated from counts (10/26 = 38.5%, 16/26 = 61.5%).
